# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph rendering hardening**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp 4.158.0 update improves mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads disagree.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts** — Mask-filtered glyph rendering respects the reloaded glyph's path, format and bounds. Incompatible or sub-byte masks produce cleared output, avoiding buffer overwrites and format assertions. Clipped embossed glyphs use full plane strides, and clearing the full destination prevents corrupted or uncleared mask planes. ([#5739](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5739))
